topics.headline: prevention turns symmetry into interruption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mirrored desire sequence is not flat mutuality; this particle turns the second half into a blocked counterfactual.

topics.headline: seeing becomes the preventive condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sight of proof is made grammatically substantive, the thing whose existence blocks completion.

words.prose: {{ar:رَّءَا}} ({{tr:raʾā}}) governs the proof as its object, making the interruption an encounter with evidence rather than a vague impulse. The verb can cover sight and judgment-forming apprehension, and the ayah leaves that channel open while keeping the local frame transitive and proof-focused; it also joins Surah Yusuf's wider vision thread from 12:4 through evidence and recognition scenes (12:28; 12:43; 12:100). Against overwhelming divine-manifestation seeing elsewhere (7:143), this proof-seeing preserves Yusuf by stopping the harmful trajectory.

topics.headline: proof is the object seen
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the interruption is not a vague feeling; the verb takes proof as its explicit object.
topics.reason: Local grammar gives the perception verb one accusative proof-object inside the nominalized prevention clause.

topics.headline: sight and apprehension remain open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah centers evidentiary perception while withholding whether that perception is optical, cognitive, or both.
topics.reason: The root and form allow sight and judgment-forming perception, but the local object narrows the claim to proof-perception rather than unbounded mental activity.

topics.headline: vision redirects the Yusuf story
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this seeing belongs to Surah Yusuf's wider vision-and-evidence pattern (12:4; 12:28; 12:43; 12:100) and contrasts with destructive divine-manifestation seeing (7:143), because here vision prevents action and preserves Yusuf.
topics.reason: Same-surah and cross-reference rows connect this seeing with dream vision (12:4), shirt proof (12:28), royal dream vision (12:43), final recognition (12:100), and the contrastive preservation-against-destruction scene (7:143), while local grammar keeps it protective.

words.root_gloss_range: proof and manifest demonstration field; local construct makes it a Lord-sourced proof rather than a generic argument
words.prose: {{ar:بُرْهَٰنَ}} ({{tr:burhāna}}) is the object seen and the construct head of the Lord-sourced proof phrase. The word carries manifest-proof force, but the content is deliberately withheld: the reader knows what the proof does and whose it is, not what it looked like. Its wider proof-formula field is inverted here: against challenge or public-proof formulas (2:111; 21:24; 28:32; 4:174), Yusuf receives proof instead of being challenged to produce it.

topics.headline: Lord-sourced proof object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof is both what Yusuf sees and what belongs to his Lord, so the interruption is sourced rather than self-generated.
topics.reason: Object grammar and construct-state grammar join perception to the Lord-source in one proof phrase.

topics.headline: clear proof with withheld content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof is forceful and manifest, while the text refuses to identify its visible content.
topics.reason: The lexical proof field, nominal form, rarity, and deliberate omission preserve function and source without importing later narrative supplements.

topics.headline: received proof instead of demanded proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a Quranic proof term used in challenge or public-proof formulas (2:111; 21:24; 28:32; 4:174) is turned here into a protective proof given to Yusuf.
topics.reason: Intertext rows contrast demanded proof (2:111; 21:24), public divine proof (28:32; 4:174), and the received proof of 12:24, with the local ayah making proof a personal protective object.

topics.headline: Lordship as cultivation and governance

topics.reason: The root field of lordship, ownership, sustaining, and cultivation remains locally relevant because the proof guides Yusuf away from harm.

topics.headline: Lord relation links refusal, proof, and later averting

topics.reason: Same-surah and co-occurrence rows connect the Lord-source of proof with Yusuf's later plea (12:33), the answer using protection vocabulary (12:34), and Lordship over indecency in 7:33.

words.prose: {{ar:نَصْرِفَ}} ({{tr:naṣrifa}}) voices the purpose as divine first-person averting: God turns the named harms away from Yusuf. The root image from {{ar:ص ر ف}} ({{tr:ṣ-r-f}}) makes protection feel like redirected trajectory, and the same protection verb becomes a Surah Yusuf thread in 12:33-34. Variant agency evidence sharpens the issue because a third-person singular reading would shift the surface toward He or it averts, but the local surface keeps direct divine agency primary. Against judgmental turning-away scenes such as 7:146 and 9:127, this clause is the protective pole: evil is turned away from the servant.

topics.headline: divine We states purposeful averting

topics.reason: Root semantics and the argument frame assign God as redirection agent, Yusuf as beneficiary, and the two harms as objects turned away.

topics.reason: Intertext and boundary rows connect the purpose verb to Yusuf's later plea (12:33), answer language (12:34), and inverse judgmental ṣarf scenes (7:146; 9:127).

topics.reason: Structural and synthesis rows show the four-beat movement from desire to interruption to divine purpose to closing classification, while 9:127 supplies the inverse target pattern for divine turning away.

words.root_gloss_range: purity, exclusivity, deliverance, and being set apart; local passive participial reading emphasizes caused purification
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ}} ({{tr:al-mukhlaṣīn}}) is the ayah's final seal: Yusuf belongs among the definite purified ones. The passive reading makes purification received and caused, not self-achieved, while variant evidence keeps the active-sincerity contrast visible. The root field adds being set apart and delivered into purified belonging, and the ending connects the narrative crisis to a broader purified-servant category, including echoes such as 15:40, 19:51, 37:40, and 38:83, before later human selection language appears in 12:54.

topics.headline: active-passive vowel contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a small reading difference can shift the emphasis from servants being sincere to servants being made pure, while the local output keeps the passive purification reading primary.
topics.reason: Variant rows are retained for agency pressure, but the canonical passive participial reading governs the local prose.

topics.headline: definite final class seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends by sealing Yusuf inside an identifiable purified-servant class, not with an unresolved crisis.
topics.reason: Agreement/apposition options, definite plural form, participial status, distribution, and closure position all make the final word a status seal.

topics.headline: caused purification and deliverance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that protection is reread as being set apart and delivered into purified belonging by another agent.
topics.reason: The root field and passive participle assign purification as caused and received rather than self-generated.

topics.headline: recognized protected category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Yusuf's final designation participates in a broader purified-servant formula and prophetic status category, with echoes such as 15:40, 19:51, 37:40, and 38:83, and it precedes later human selection language in 12:54.
topics.reason: Intertext rows link the closing word with servant-purification formulas (15:40; 37:40; 38:83), prophetic designation (19:51), later royal selection language (12:54), and later same-surah root contrast (12:80).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired هَمَّتْ and هَمَّ, the لَوْلَا clause, and the sequence of seeing proof followed by turning-away.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two inward orientations reach a narrated threshold, but perception of proof interrupts equivalence and divine redirection changes the trajectory before the intended relation becomes completed action.

activation_trace.role: The branch gives both mirrored verbs inwardly formed concern or resolve, making the threshold live rather than grammatically empty.
Sense or insight supplies the interrupting apprehension through which the scene is newly perceived.
Demonstrative proof gives the perception evidentiary force rather than leaving it a bare emotional recoil.
Turning something back from its face supplies the decisive change of direction away from the threatened outcome.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a flat contrast between her desire and his absence of desire.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages mirrored, genuinely formed orientation at a threshold, then marks the asymmetry as an interruption by apprehended proof and a redirected course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ السُّوءَ وَالْفَحْشَاءَ and the closing description الْمُخْلَصِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Protection is spatial and processual: evil and excess are turned off his path while he is purified from admixture and extracted from what could ensnare him. The objects are not necessarily identical; general harm, sexual exposure, and exceeded bounds remain layered.

activation_trace.role: Transfer from one state or course to another makes protection a rerouting process, not merely a verdict about character.
The concealed sexual or shame-bearing exposure sharpens one bodily and reputational layer of what is turned away.
Exceeding a proper limit makes the danger an escalation beyond measure, broader than one named act.
Purification after mixture supplies the selective clarification of the servant through contact with, not ignorance of, danger.
Escape after becoming caught supplies the rescue dimension, keeping chosen status compatible with a real snare.

changed_reading.before: Being chosen means possessing a static purity that prevents any real proximity to temptation.
changed_reading.after: Being chosen is disclosed as active extraction, rerouting, and clarification within a real field of harm and exceeded limits.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The proof is specifically بُرْهَانَ رَبِّهِ, and the explanation closes with مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُخْلَصِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The proof belongs to a lordly relation of ownership, repair, and staged formation. Servanthood supplies responsive obedience, while chosen distinctness explains why the intervention belongs to an ongoing relation rather than an isolated visual event.

activation_trace.role: Gradual repair, nurture, and completion make the proof an act within continuing formation.
Obedience with humble service supplies the human response within that formative relation.
Selection and distinction from competing claims give the servant a particular belonging and orientation.
Established evidence functions as the timely medium through which formation becomes directive.

changed_reading.before: A detached sign suddenly suppresses an otherwise self-contained episode.
changed_reading.after: The seen proof is a timely act of an already formative lord-servant relation that repairs direction and confirms particular belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus sequence moves Joseph through concealment, commodification, diminished valuation, honored lodging, empowerment, and corrective judgment. This makes chosen servanthood a capacity formed and preserved through alien ownership systems rather than an untouched essence outside them.

activation_trace.role: Purification after admixture anchors the claim that prior social handling can be traversed without defining the servant.
Hiding something inward supplies the first imposed concealment through which Joseph is handled.
A cut-off portion of wealth becoming merchandise supplies the objectifying economic frame.
Reduction from due worth makes the external valuation explicitly deficient.
Honorable generosity reverses the preceding deficient valuation without yet granting full autonomy.
Empowerment supplies a counter-current of granted capacity within the same land and household.
Preventive restraint for repair anticipates the focus verse's redirection as trained judgment.

structural_cues: 12:19-22 moves from concealed merchandise and diminished price to honored lodging, empowerment, maturity, judgment, and knowledge immediately before the focus scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive reversals of valuation and a grant of corrective judgment; I infer that these stages form preserved agency culminating in 12:24. A live alternative is that they establish biography and providence without specifying the mechanism of resistance.

changed_reading.before: الْمُخْلَصِينَ is only a timeless honorific attached after the event.
changed_reading.after: The title gathers a prior process in which external owners repeatedly redefine Joseph while lordly formation preserves and equips an agency not reducible to their valuations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated solicitation is staged inside deliberately tightened architecture: doors are made fast, an imperative summons him, and he seeks refuge. The mirrored هَمَّ clauses therefore occur in an asymmetric field of pursuit, enclosure, and attempted refusal, while divine turning opens a direction unavailable in the closed room.

activation_trace.role: Formed inward orientation remains the focus anchor, but context changes the pressures under which each orientation forms.
Persistent solicitation toward an act supplies her directed pursuit rather than a merely simultaneous feeling.
Coercive tightening and constriction make the closure an exertion of control over the available courses.
The entryway image turns the room into a system of channels whose exits have been controlled.
An explicit summons supplies the verbal force pressing the encounter toward enactment.
Seeking refuge and protective attachment supplies Joseph's already stated counter-orientation.
Redirection away from a faced course functions as an opening in the otherwise narrowed choice-space.

structural_cues: 12:23 places solicitation, multiplied door-closing, summons, and refuge directly before the paired هَمَّ clauses.
The first narrated bodily movement after 12:24 is toward the door rather than toward the summoner.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed pursuit, controlled exits, summons, and refuge; I infer that the architecture makes the two intentions functionally unequal and that divine turning restores an exit-course. Alternatively, the enclosure may intensify the scene without altering the lexical force of his هَمَّ.

changed_reading.before: The paired verbs describe two isolated and freely symmetrical desires.
changed_reading.after: They are verbally mirrored but causally asymmetric: her sustained pursuit narrows the room, his live inward threshold occurs after refuge within that pressure, and the decisive change is a restored direction out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inward turn becomes bodily flight; flight leaves a directional tear; the tear becomes a witnessed criterion; and sight later reads that criterion. The aftermath does not identify the earlier برهان, but it places it in a broader proof ecology where moral direction becomes material and legible.

activation_trace.role: Established demonstration anchors the focus event as proof-bearing rather than only affective.
A course turned away supplies the inward directional change that the following movement externalizes.
Advancing in a race supplies rapid opposed motion toward the exit.
The entryway becomes the concrete destination through which redirection is enacted and exposed.
A lengthwise tear supplies a durable material trace generated by the opposed movement.
The worn shirt is the body-adjacent surface that receives and preserves the trace.
Turning one's back gives the tear directional meaning as evidence of withdrawal.
A sign that bears witness converts the damaged garment from residue into an evidentiary criterion.
Front-facing orientation supplies the counterfactual direction against which the rear tear is tested.
Stable verification supplies the criterion's capacity to establish which account holds.
Later sight reads the physical sign, echoing the focus sequence of seeing and proof without equating the two objects.

structural_cues: 12:25 converts the focus redirection into a race to the door and a shirt torn from behind.
12:26-28 orders witness, front-versus-back testing, and sight of the rear tear as a public verification sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward flight, a directionally marked tear, and its later evidentiary reading; I infer that these externalize the moral vector of صَرْف and illuminate what proof does in the scene. The live alternative is that the focus برهان is a wholly distinct prior disclosure and the shirt only corroborates innocence afterward.

changed_reading.before: The seen proof is a private apparition whose effect leaves no inspectable relation to subsequent events.
changed_reading.after: The proof initiates a direction that becomes embodied in flight and later legible through a material witness, while the earlier and later proofs remain distinguishable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The danger expands from a closed encounter into a circuit of report, gaze, affect, and bodily injury. What is turned away from Joseph includes not only a proposed act but a spectacle that recruits other viewers and makes bodies bear the excess.

activation_trace.role: Shame-bearing sexual exposure anchors the reputational and bodily danger that can spread beyond the room.
Excess beyond proper measure supplies the category under which social fascination becomes bodily overrun.
Love reaching the heart's enclosing layer supplies an affect imagined as penetrating inward boundaries.
Love adhering to the heart supplies the persistent affect that public speech attributes to the encounter.
Report spreading among people supplies the social transmission that carries the private scene outward.
Direct sight supplies the activating gaze through which the reported desire is experimentally reproduced.
Severing and separation supply the literal bodily consequence of affect exceeding controlled measure.
The bodily hand localizes the injury, making the spectacle's harm visible rather than metaphorical.

structural_cues: 12:30-31 moves from city speech about desire to a staged viewing in which multiple women reproduce astonishment and cut their hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public report, orchestrated sight, and bodily cutting; I infer that السوء والفحشاء can include a socially amplified economy of exposure and harm, not just a private sexual endpoint. Alternatively, the later spectacle may illustrate only Joseph's beauty and leave the focus objects narrowly moral.

changed_reading.before: السوء والفحشاء name one private act proposed by one woman.
changed_reading.after: They can also name the expanding system of exposure, contagious gaze, affective excess, and bodily damage from which Joseph's course is kept distinct.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later speech names his active holding-fast, renewed solicitation, coercive threat, acknowledged possibility of inclination, petition for turning, and received answer. Divine protection and human agency are therefore coupled, and chosen status does not erase vulnerability or dependence.

activation_trace.role: Rescue after entanglement anchors chosen status as deliverance compatible with genuine exposure.
The repeated solicitation confirms that the pressure persists after the focus rescue.
The inward faculty of mind and response identifies the contested site as personal agency, not only external movement.
Grasping that prevents and preserves supplies an active human form taken by protection.
Confinement supplies the coercive cost threatened against continued resistance.
Highest preference makes prison a consciously ranked cost rather than an accidental escape.
Calling that verbally inclines another supplies the continuing interpersonal pull against which aid is sought.
The focus verb reappears as requested redirection, converting the earlier explanation into an explicit dependence.
Inclination of the heart supplies the vulnerability Joseph himself treats as materially possible.
Disordered restraint and temperament supply the feared consequence of yielding, not merely missing information.
A returned answer closes the petition-response circuit and attributes effective aid to relation.
Actual redirection answers the requested turning and repeats the focus mechanism under widened pressure.

structural_cues: 12:32 joins confession of solicitation and self-restraint to a threat of prison and humiliation.
12:33 conditionally admits possible inclination unless God turns the women's pressure away, and 12:34 narrates response and turning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active self-restraint, costly preference, admitted possible inclination, petition, and answer; I infer that 12:24 describes relationally sustained protection rather than ontological invulnerability. Alternatively, 12:24 may narrate one completed rescue while 12:33-34 begins a separate rescue from collective pressure.

changed_reading.before: Divine turning cancels human agency and proves that a chosen servant cannot experience subsequent inclination.
changed_reading.after: Divine turning is enacted through holding-fast, costly choice, candid vulnerability, prayer, and response; chosenness secures relation and rescue, not effortless immunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs can establish moral direction and still fail to control a household's institutional decision. The focus proof effectively redirects Joseph, but proof's efficacy must be separated from immediate release, vindication, or freedom from imposed consequences.

activation_trace.role: Demonstrative proof anchors the distinction between evidence's directive force and political enforcement.
Emergence into visibility supplies the public availability of what had become evident.
Perception of the signs echoes the focus act of seeing while shifting the viewers to the ruling household.
An outwardly manifest sign supplies evidence that is acknowledged before the contrary decision.
Confinement supplies the institutionally imposed outcome that visible evidence does not prevent.
A bounded interval makes the adverse consequence temporally real even if it is not final.

structural_cues: 12:35 explicitly sequences seeing the signs before deciding on imprisonment for a time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perceived signs followed by timed confinement; I infer that proof can succeed in redirecting the servant while failing to compel the powerful. Alternatively, the imprisonment may itself be another means by which harm is turned away, making institutional defeat simultaneously protective.

changed_reading.before: Seeing divine proof should remove danger, vindicate innocence, and prevent adverse consequences in the same register.
changed_reading.after: Proof redirects the moral course and can make truth visible without immediately defeating coercive power; even imprisonment may remain either harm or a second protective diversion.

Downstream prose should call it a split-root echo, not translate رَاوَدَتْ as repulsion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus redirects a formed orientation away, while the immediately preceding solicitation has a packet-supplied alternate mapping whose branch pushes back and prevents.

activation_trace.role: Repelling and preventing supplies a latent inverse vector inside the mapped inventory of the pursuit cue.
Turning back from a faced course anchors that inverse vector in the focus verse's explicit action.

changed_reading.before: Solicitation and protection are only sequential, externally opposed events.
changed_reading.after: At the packet's split-root level, pursuit carries a shadow of return and repulsion, allowing the scene to be heard as competing vectors already folded around the threshold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the non-dominant ر و ي mapping for the QAC root ر ء ي. It remains anchored to رَأَى and explains how proof could alter an already formed هَمّ by restoring reflective interval. Downstream prose should present it as an abductive activation, not as the lexical replacement of seeing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَأَى occurs precisely between the paired intentions and the explanatory divine turning.

activation_trace.role: Inwardly formed resolve supplies the state that requires interruption rather than mere information.
Deliberative consideration supplies a recovered pause in which the formed course can be reassessed.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the proof is an instantaneous visual shock acting independently of thought.
changed_reading.after: The sight may also activate recovered deliberation, widening a constricted instant enough for intention to be re-read and redirected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it carries ه م م through melting and flow imagery rather than its primary intentional branch. It remains anchored to the repeated verb, explicit transposition in صَرْف, and subsequent race toward the door. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for activation dynamics, not a dictionary gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated هَمَّ supplies rising activation, and نَصْرِفَ explicitly changes its threatened course before the body races toward the exit.

activation_trace.role: Melting and movement after rigidity model intention as activation passing from held state toward flow.
Transfer between states or courses supplies the rerouting of that activation rather than its annihilation.
Rapid forward competition gives the rerouted activation a bodily outlet toward escape.

changed_reading.before: The episode switches desire off and replaces motion with stillness.
changed_reading.after: The episode may reroute already mobilized energy: incipient flow is not erased but converted into rapid flight from the threatened act.

strongest_changes: The mirrored هَمَّ clauses remain real but cease to be causally symmetrical once solicitation, enclosure, refuge, proof, and restored exit-direction are integrated.
الْمُخْلَصِينَ shifts from static immunity to extraction, formed agency, and relationally sustained rescue within genuine vulnerability.
The torn shirt and its directional reading do not identify the focus برهان, but they reveal a proof ecology in which inward redirection becomes bodily and publicly legible.
The later repetition of صَرْف as petition and answer makes protection a coupled process of restraint, costly choice, admitted susceptibility, prayer, and response.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse concentrates intention, perception, proof, spatial redirection, moral danger, servanthood, and purification into one hinge. Context repeatedly unfolds those compressed terms into architecture, movement, material evidence, social contagion, coercion, and renewed dependence without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether his هَمَّ denotes equivalent desire, incipient action, reactive movement, or a deliberately suspended threshold remains grammatically unresolved even after the causal asymmetry is clearer.
Whether السوء and الفحشاء distinguish internal inclination from external coercion, sexual act from public exposure, or general harm from exceeded limit remains multiply live.
The identity and mode of the seen برهان remain unspecified; the later shirt-sign clarifies proof function but should not be collapsed into the earlier object.
Imprisonment can be read both as proof's institutional defeat and as a second protective redirection, and the packet does not require choosing between them.

I infer that one protection blocks harmful consequence and the other blocks boundary-violating act. The paired nouns preserve social and moral dimensions rather than reducing the scene to one category.

Dalların bir bölümü su, taşıma ve doluluk benzetileriyle tarihsel olarak ilişkilendirilebilse de çağdaş kavram haritasında ayrı sınırlar gerektirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hem bir savi tasiyan guclu kaniti hem de bu kaniti birine karsi ortaya koyma eylemini verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi kullanilabilir; yalniz ad gibi duran anlam ile belirli soz obegindeki eylem anlami birbirine karistirilmamalidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yalniz olmayan turdedir; tanim, ad gibi duran kanit anlamini ve soz obegine bagli eylem anlamini ayri tutar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ad gibi duran kullanimda, savi tasiyan guclu ve acik kanit kastedildiginde uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da savi destekleyen guclu kanit alaninda bulusur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, baskin ve karsi tarafi susturan yetkili kanit tonunu one cikarir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da karsi tarafi baglayan guclu kanit fikri vardir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalin siniri acik ve guclu kanit ile kaniti ileri surme eylemidir; komsu dalda ise kanitin baskinlik, yetke ve ustun gelme etkisi daha belirgin bir sinir olusturur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kanit, dogrulugu ortaya koyma surecinde kullanilabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dalin cekirdegi dogrunun sabitlenmesi ve gosterilmesidir; odak dal bu sonuctan cok, savi tasiyan guclu kanit ve onun ileri surulmesiyle ilgilidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, kaniti kurma ve ileri surme yonunu tasir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, kanitin dusmesi, gecersizlesmesi ya da baska bir yolla bozulmasi yonunu tasir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da kanitin tartisma icindeki durumunu ele alir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kanitin guclu bicimde ortaya konmasi tarafindadir; komsu dal ayni alanda kanitin yikilmasi veya gecersiz kalmasi tarafini temsil eder.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aciklama ve belirginlesme, kanitin anlasilmasina yardim edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal aciklik ve gorunur hale gelme alanindadir; odak dal ise acikligin kendisinden ziyade savi destekleyen kanit ve bu kanitin ortaya konmasi alanindadir.

branches.branch_image_ar: تقليب وتصريف من حال إلى حال
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تصريف الرياح والسيول والخيول والأمور والآيات والكلام والكلمة، أي نقلها أو إجراؤها من وجه إلى وجه ومن حال إلى حال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: تصريف الرياح تصرفها من وجه إلى وجه وحال إلى حال وكذلك تصريف الخيول والسيول والأمور (ayn)؛ تصريف الآيات تبيينها (tahdhib)؛ التصريف كالصرف إلا في التكثير وأكثر ما يقال في صرف الشيء من حالة إلى حالة (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحيلة والتصرف في الأمور، والصيرف أو الصيرفي بمعنى المحتال المتقلب المجرب، والاكتساب بالتصرف للعيال.

branches.branch_image_ar: صرف يقابل العدل في القبول أو الدفع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصرف في عبارة لا يقبل منه صرف ولا عدل، وما فسر بالتوبة أو النافلة أو الحيلة، وكذلك صرفا بمعنى وسيلة دفع أو تحويل في مقابلة النصر.
يدخل فيه بيع الذهب بالفضة، وصرف الدراهم بالدنانير، وفضل الدرهم على الدرهم في القيمة أو جودة الفضة، واسم الصيرفي والصراف.
يدخل فيه صرف الحديث أو الكلام بمعنى تزيينه والزيادة فيه حتى تميل الأسماع أو القلوب إليه، وفضل بعض الكلام على بعض.
يدخل فيه حدث الدهر ونوائبه وصروفه، وما يتقلب بالناس من أمور الزمان، والصرفان إذا أريد بهما الليل والنهار.
يدخل فيه الصرفة اسما لمنزل أو كوكب، وتسميتها بانصراف البرد أو إقبال الحر، وقولهم ناب الدهر.
يدخل فيه الصرفة خرزة أو أخذ يزعم به صرف قلب الرجل عما يريد.
يدخل فيه الصراف أو الصرافة للشاء والبقر والكلاب والسباع إذا اشتهت الفحل، وناقة أو كلبة أو عنز صارف.
يدخل فيه صريف ناب البعير، وصريف البكرة، وصريف الباب، وما أشبهه من صوت يرده الاحتكاك أو الدوران.

branches.branch_image_ar: صريف لبن أو خمر مأخوذ لساعته
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصريف للبن ساعة يحلب أو حين تنصرف عنه الرغوة، والصريف أو الصريفية للخمر الطيبة المأخوذة من دنها لساعتها.
يدخل فيه شراب صرف غير ممزوج، وكل شيء خالص لا خلط فيه، والصرف صبغ أحمر أو لون الأديم الخالص الشديد الحمرة.

Bu değerlendirme kişiye, söze, işe, davranışa ve utanç verici bir duruma uygulanabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Önceki karışandan arınmaya götüren süreç ve durum değişikliği bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hiç karıştırılmamış içecek ve tek başına yoğun renk gibi baştan beri yalın durumları kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da başka bir öğeyle karışmama niteliği bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, önceki karışanın giderildiği bir dönüşümü bildirir. Komşu dal ise böyle bir dönüşüm olmadan karışıksızlığı ve kimi yoğun renk kullanımlarını adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her tür nesnede karışanı giderip duru bir sonuca ulaşan genel süreci anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yağ işleminde kullanılan katkı, çıkan öz, dip tortusu ve hurma şurubu gibi geleneksel yiyecek adlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yiyecek hazırlamadaki bazı kullanımlar ayırma ve arıtma düşüncesiyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel bir arıtma ve durulma anlamıdır. Komşu dal aynı imgeyle bağlantılı olsa da belirli yiyecek süreçlerindeki araç, ürün ve kalıntı adlarından oluşan özel bir söz varlığı kümesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu dal iddiası, bir kişi ya da şeyin takılıp kaldığı bağdan sıyrılarak güvenli duruma geçmesini ve bir başkasının onu bu bağdan çıkarmasını açıkça birleştirir. Kaçma örneği bu kurtulma çekirdeğinin özel bir görünümüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kendi kendine kurtulma, bir başkasını kurtarma ve kaçıp uzaklaşma kullanımları ayrı katılımcı yapılarıyla korunur; bunlar yalın bir duruluk anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şeyin takıldığı bağdan, tuzaktan veya engelleyici durumdan sıyrılıp güvenli duruma geçmesi; geçişli kullanımda bir başkasının onu bu durumdan çıkarmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kurtulan kişi ya da şey önceden bir bağa, tuzağa veya engelleyici duruma takılmıştır.
Bu bağlı durumdan sıyrılma, güvenli ve serbest bir sonuca geçiş sağlar.
Geçişli kullanımda bir kurtarıcı, takılmış kişi ya da şeyi bağdan uzaklaştırır.
Kaçıp uzaklaşma, bağlı durumdan sıyrılmanın özel bir gerçekleşmesi olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tuzağa veya başka bir bağa takıldıktan sonra kurtulmayı, birini bu bağdan kurtarmayı ve kaçışı aynı çekirdek çevresinde toplar. Yalnızca serbestçe gitmek değil, engelleyici bir ilişkiden çıkmak belirleyicidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin ya da şeyin önceden yakalandığı, tutulduğu veya takıldığı bir durumdan sıyrılmasını anlatan genel karşılıktır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir öznenin başka bir kişi ya da şeyi takıldığı bağdan çıkardığı geçişli bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kurtarıcının bağlı durumdaki varlığı engelden çıkarmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağdan sıyrılmanın kaçma yoluyla gerçekleştiği özel kullanımda uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kötülükten kurtulma ve genel ayrılma gibi fiziksel takılma gerektirmeyen alanlara yayılır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: takıldığı bağdan kurtulma ile genel kurtuluş
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da zarar verici bir durumdan ayrılıp güvenli hale gelmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda önceki takılma veya bağlanma ve bu bağdan sıyrılma belirgindir. Komşu dal kötülükten kurtulma ve genel ayrılma gibi daha geniş sonuçları da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir başkasının elinden veya belirgin bir beladan kurtarma eylemini daha güçlü biçimde öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir kişi ya da şeyi sıkışık veya tehlikeli durumdan çıkarma vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı özelliği takılı kalmışlıktan sıyrılmadır ve geçişsiz kurtulmayı da kapsar. Komşu dal, özellikle dışarıdan bir kurtarıcının beladan ya da başkasının elinden çıkarmasına yönelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kaçış olsun olmasın, önceden takılmış durumdan serbest ve güvenli sonuca geçişi gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bağ veya tuzak bulunmaksızın her türlü kaçma ve kaçış olayını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kaçmak, bazı bağlamlarda bağlı durumdan kurtulmanın yolu olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda kaçış yalnızca takılı durumdan sıyrılmanın bir örneğidir. Komşu dal kaçma eylemini kendi başına adlandırır ve başarılı kurtuluş ya da önceki bir bağ gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tuzak, bağ veya başka bir engelden kurtulmayı, bedel koşuluna bakmadan genel olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tutsağı karşılık almadan serbest bırakma biçimini özellikle bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da tutulan bir kişinin serbest hale gelmesi söz konusu olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği engelleyici bağdan sıyrılmadır. Komşu dal ise tutsaklık alanında, salıvermenin karşılıksız yapılmasını kurucu koşul olarak taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlı ya da nesnenin onu tutan bağdan çıkıp serbest hale gelmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir nesnedeki karışımın veya bulanıklığın giderilerek nesnenin durulmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da istenmeyen bir ilişkiden ayrılma ve daha serbest bir sonuç imgesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın katılımcısı bir bağa veya tuzağa takılmıştır ve ondan kurtulur. Komşu dalda ise nesnenin içindeki karışan giderilir; tuzak, güvenlik ve kaçış ilişkisi bulunmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Genel kurtuluş, dışarıdan kurtarma, kaçış, tutsak salıverme ve aynı kökün arıtma dalı en yararlı sınırları verdi; sığınma, yardım, ulaşma ve ilgisiz yerel dallar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خلص الشيء أو الشخص إذا كان قد نشب ثم نجا وسلم، وتخليصه وتنحيته من كل ما ينشب، والتخلص من الحبالة، وفرار خلبص مع زيادة الباء.
branches.source_phrase_ar: خلصته من كذا وخلص هو (maqayis)؛ كان قد نشب ثم نجا وسلم (ayn;tahdhib)؛ تخلص الظبي والطائر من الحبالة إذا أفلت منها (jamhara)؛ نجيته فتخلص (sihah)؛ التخليص التنحية من كل منشب (tahdhib)؛ خلبص الرجل إذا فر والباء فيه زائدة وهو من خلص (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خلص إلى فلان أو خلص إليه الشيء بمعنى وصل إليه وانتهى.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu dal iddiası, bir şeyi yalnız bir kişi ya da topluluğa ayırmayı, kişinin onu kendine özgü kılmasını ve bir topluluğun başkalarından ayrılmasını ortak bir dışlayıcı özgüleme ilişkisi altında tutarlı biçimde toplar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bir şeyi birine ayıran yapılar ile bir topluluğun ötekilerden ayrılması aynı dışlayıcı çekirdekte, fakat ayrı katılımcı düzenleri olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yalnız belirli bir kişi ya da topluluğa ayırarak başkalarının ortaklığını dışlama; topluluk kullanımında ise ötekilerden ayrılıp kendi başına kalmadır.

facets.statement: Bir şey belirli bir kişi ya da topluluğa özgülenir ve başkalarının ortaklığı dışlanır.
Kişi bir şeyi yalnız kendisi için seçip ayırabilir.
Bir topluluk, başkalarından ayrılarak kendi içinde tek başına kalabilir.
Bir nimetin yalnız inananlara ayrılması, başkalarının ortaklığının dışlandığı bir örnektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, bir nesneyi yalnız birine ayırma, kişinin onu kendisi için seçmesi ve bir topluluğun ötekilerden ayrılması kullanımlarını başkalarının ortaklığını dışlama ekseninde birleştirir. Nesne özgüleme ile topluluk ayrışması aynı katılımcı yapısı değildir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyi belirli kişi ya da topluluğa özgü kılmayı ve bir topluluğun ötekilerden ayrılıp kendi içinde kalmasını birlikte özetler.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli yararlanıcıya özgülemeyi, başkalarının ortaklığını dışlamayı ve topluluğun ötekilerden ayrılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin yalnız belirtilen kişiye verildiği ve başkalarının paydaş olmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli yararlanıcıya özgü ayırmayı ve ortaklığı dışlamayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bir şeyi başkaları olmaksızın yalnız kendi kullanımı için seçtiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin şeyi kendisi için seçmesini ve diğerlerini dışlamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun başkalarından ayrılıp kendi içinde kaldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun başkalarından ayrılması ve bağımsız kalması yönünü korur.
Bir şeyi kendine bağlama yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi başkasına özgüleme ve topluluğun ötekilerden ayrılması kullanımlarını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Mülkiyeti edinme veya duygusal koruma anlamlarını ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda kişi bir şeyi başkalarının ortaklığı olmadan kendine ayırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal odak dalın kendine ayırma görünümüne çok yaklaşır, ancak yalnız kişinin şeyi kendine saklamasını anlatır. Odak dal başka bir yararlanıcıya ayırmayı ve topluluk ayrışmasını da taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Özgüleme tarafsız olabilir ve yararlanıcı kişinin kendisi olmak zorunda değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin arkadaşları karşısında kendini kayırarak şeyi tek başına almasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da başkalarının payı dışlanarak bir şey tek kişiye kalabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği bir şeyi belirli tarafa ayırmaktır ve değer yargısı taşımaz. Komşu dal kişinin kendisini arkadaşlarına üstün tutması biçimindeki tek yanlı yararlanmayı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Nesne, yarar veya topluluğun başkalarından ayrı tutulmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yakın dostları, özel çevreyi ve ilişkide içtenliği bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Belirli kişilerin ötekilerden farklı ve yakın bir çevre oluşturması iki dalı ilişkilendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda özel olma, başkalarının ortaklığını dışlayan ayırma ilişkisidir. Komşu dalda ise özel kişiler dostluk ve içten sevgi bağıyla tanımlanır; mülk ya da yarar özgüleme gerekmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كون الشيء خالصة أو خاصا لشخص أو جماعة، واستخصاص الشيء للنفس، وانفراد قوم عن غيرهم، وتميزهم عن الناس.
branches.source_phrase_ar: هذا الشيء خالصة لك أي خالص لك خاصة (ayn;tahdhib)؛ خذ هذه خالصة لك (jamhara)؛ استخلصه لنفسه أي استخصه (sihah)؛ خلصوا نجيا معناه تميزوا عن الناس (tahdhib)؛ انفردوا خالصين عن غيرهم (mufradat)؛ خلصت للمؤمنين في الآخرة ولا يشركهم فيها كافر (tahdhib)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإخلاص بمعنى توحيد الله، وإمحاض الدين له، وترك الرياء في الطاعة، والتبري مما دون الله.
يدخل فيه المخلَصون بمعنى المختارين، وأخلصناهم بمعنى جعلناهم خالصين لله بذكر الدار والآخرة.
يدخل فيه الخالص والخلصاني والخلصاء بمعنى الأخلاء أو الخاصة، وإخلاص الود، والمصافاة في العشرة.
يدخل فيه خلاصة السمن والخلاص وما يلقى من تمر أو سويق ليخلص به السمن، وما يخلص من الزبد واللبن، والثفل أو الباقي في أسفل البرمة، ورب التمر المسمى خلاصا.

Dallar ayrılma ve tekleşme imgesini paylaşsa da her biri kendi katılımcıları ve kullanım sınırlarıyla bağımsızdır.
